title: Advanced Financial Accounting
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a specialized form of bill of exchange, drawn on a banker and payable on demand."
A cheque is a specialized form of bill of exchange, drawn on a banker and payable on demand.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with 'general purpose' financial statements (i.e. a normal set of annual statements), but it can be applied to other types of accounts."
Components of Financial Statements The Framework is concerned with 'general purpose' financial statements (i.e. a normal set of annual statements), but it can be applied to other types of accounts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the power to participate in the financial and operating policy decisions of the investee but does not have control over those policies."
Significant influence is the power to participate in the financial and operating policy decisions of the investee but does not have control over those policies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a legal status of a person or other entity that cannot repay the debts it owes to creditors."
Bankruptcy is a legal status of a person or other entity that cannot repay the debts it owes to creditors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Statement that shows Assets, Liabilities and Net Assets / Equity of the enterprise."
Statement of Financial Position is a Statement that shows Assets, Liabilities and Net Assets / Equity of the enterprise.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a trader who (as principal) sends goods to another (the agent) to sell them on his behalf for a reward, that is for commission."
A consignor A consignor is a trader who (as principal) sends goods to another (the agent) to sell them on his behalf for a reward, that is for commission.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the actuarial present value at a specified date of all benefits attributed by the pension benefit formula to employee service rendered prior to the specified date."

Projected Benefit Obligation (PBO) is the actuarial present value at a specified date of all benefits attributed by the pension benefit formula to employee service rendered prior to the specified date.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a retailer trading in Portharcourt using agents to sell goods in Ibadan.The arrangement is that the agent sells goods at cost plus one - third and earns a commission of 2/2% on all sales."

ALABO LTD is a retailer trading in Portharcourt using agents to sell goods in Ibadan.The arrangement is that the agent sells goods at cost plus one - third and earns a commission of 2/2% on all sales.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the payment made by the sub-lessee to the original lessee (tenant)."
Sub-royalty is the payment made by the sub-lessee to the original lessee (tenant).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the present value of those future benefits."
The asset ceiling is the present value of those future benefits.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an enterprise that is controlled by another enterprise known as the parent."
A subsidiary is an enterprise that is controlled by another enterprise known as the parent.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a basic tool in valuing common stock."
The DDM is a basic tool in valuing common stock.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the remuneration payable to a person in respect of the use of an asset or right like mine, copyright or patent to its owner."
Royalty is the remuneration payable to a person in respect of the use of an asset or right like mine, copyright or patent to its owner.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a good predictor of the future if all relevant variables remain constant or nearly constant."
Past trend often is a good predictor of the future if all relevant variables remain constant or nearly constant.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the employee's service or compensation or both."
Pension benefit formulas usually refer to the employee's service or compensation or both.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the Statements required by IAS 7 to be presented in the GPFS."
Statement of Cash flow is one of the Statements required by IAS 7 to be presented in the GPFS.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a first semester, three credit and 400 level core course."
ACC419 is a first semester, three credit and 400 level core course.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a joint arrangement whereby the parties that have joint control of the arrangement have right to the assets and obligations for the liabilities relating to the arrangement."
Joint operation is a joint arrangement whereby the parties that have joint control of the arrangement have right to the assets and obligations for the liabilities relating to the arrangement.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the actuarial present of the benefits attributed by the pension benefit formula to services rendered by the employees during the current period."
Service Cost is the actuarial present of the benefits attributed by the pension benefit formula to services rendered by the employees during the current period.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the cash flow left over after the firm fulfills certain obligations."
Free cash flow (FCF) Free cash flow is the cash flow left over after the firm fulfills certain obligations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the financial statements of a group presented as those of a single enterprise."
Consolidated financial statements are the financial statements of a group presented as those of a single enterprise.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those in which a parent company has only a direct interest in the shares of its subsidiary companies."
Group structure The simplest are those in which a parent company has only a direct interest in the shares of its subsidiary companies.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the process of reducing a recognised liability systematically by recognizing revenues or reducing a recognized asset systematically by recognizing expenses or costs."
Amortization Usually refers to the process of reducing a recognised liability systematically by recognizing revenues or reducing a recognized asset systematically by recognizing expenses or costs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the average remaining service life of active plan participants."
The amortization period is the average remaining service life of active plan participants.
